records.text: And I heard that from people at Turning Point USA and I heard it from a person outside of Turning Point USA who knew Charlie (Charlie Kirk) and said that Charlie (Charlie Kirk) was gearing up to fire Tyler Bowyer, the person who introduced him and Erika (Erika Kirk).
